Mergers & Acquisitions Analyst Konecranes 3.1 3.1/5 tähteä Espoo   Sijainti Espoo   Täydellinen työnkuvaus Company Description At Konecranes, we believe that great customer experience is built on the people behind the Konecranes name. Everything we do, we do with passion and drive. We believe diversity drives business success and is the foundation for our growth. We welcome different backgrounds and skills that enrich our community and we promote a place where we can ALL be ourselves. This is what makes Konecranes a unique place to work. Job Description We are looking for an Mergers & Acquisition Analyst to join Konecranes’ Corporate Mergers & Acquisitions team. This role offers an excellent opportunity to build hands‑on M&A experience in a global industrial company. You will work closely with experienced M&A professionals and senior leaders, supporting transactions and strategic investment decisions that shape the future of Konecranes. Location: Konecranes is headquartered in Hyvinkää, Finland. This role is primarily based at our modern offices in Keilaranta, Espoo, where the team is located. We work in a hybrid model and enjoy collaborating in the office, with around 50% of your working time spent on-site. Occasional travel is part of the role. Travel is limited in the beginning (approximately 10 days per year, depending on project needs) and may increase over time. Key responsibilities: Support in evaluating investment opportunities, including market, financial, and strategic analysis. Participate in due diligence processes across financial, commercial, tax, legal, HR and operational areas. Prepare valuation models (DCF, multiples-based valuation, scenario analyses). Assist in the preparation of investment proposals, presentations, and internal decision materials. Conduct industry and competitor research to support M&A pipeline development. Coordinate with internal stakeholders (finance, legal, business units) and external advisors. Qualifications We are looking for a structured and hands‑on professional who enjoys working in an ambitious environment. You are motivated to learn and take responsibility, while working closely with experienced colleagues. You are comfortable working with numbers and complex topics to support business decisions, and you approach your work with a collaborative mindset. What we expect: Approximately 1-5 years of relevant work experience in M&A, transaction services, audit, business controlling, due diligence or business development. A relevant master's degree in finance, accounting, economics or a related field. Solid understanding and ability to evaluate financial information. Financial modelling skills, including experience with DCF, multiples‑based valuation and scenario analysis. Strong analytical skills and the ability to support the analysis of complex problems using data and financial information. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with multiple stakeholders across functions in a multinational environment. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; additional languages are an advantage. Experience in an industrial or international material handling business environment is a plus. Additional Information Why join us? This role offers a unique opportunity to learn hands‑on M&A work in a global industrial company. You will work closely with experienced professionals who are committed to supporting your development and sharing their expertise. As part of the Corporate M&A team, you will gain exposure to real investment projects and contribute to analyses and materials that support senior management decision‑making. The role provides a strong overview of how strategic transactions are evaluated and executed in an international business environment. In addition, we offer: Flexible and hybrid working with the possibility to work remotely. Competitive salary and performance-based incentives, together with a comprehensive benefits package, including ePassi Welfare benefit, free gyms at our Hyvinkää and Espoo offices, and an insurance fund. The opportunity to participate in our Employee Share Savings Plan. Konecranes cottages available for rent. Multiple sports and leisure activities through Koneen Kerho ry, such as sports, networking, and cooking classes. Want to learn more about Konecranes and what your future colleagues have to say – visit our Career pages! Interested? Please submit your application and CV by 23.6.2026, using the Apply link below. Please note that we review applications on an ongoing basis, and the recruitment process will be closed once a suitable candidate has been selected. We look forward to hearing from you! For more information about the role, please contact Sakari Laine, Vice President, Mergers & Acquisitions via phone +358 40 752 0048 during the following times: 17 June at 14-15, and 23 June at 14-15. Konecranes moves what matters. We are a global leader in material handling solutions, serving a broad range of customers across multiple industries. We consistently set the industry benchmark, from everyday improvements to the breakthroughs at moments that matter most, because we know we can always find a safer, more productive and sustainable way. That's why, with 16 000+ professionals in over 50 countries, we are trusted every day to lift, handle and move what the world needs. paragraphs: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Mergers & Acquisitions Analyst position at Extract via OpenClaw. My unique blend of legal expertise and event coordination experience makes me an ideal candidate for this role, as I possess the ability to analyze complex transactions while also managing multiple stakeholders effectively.

My hands-on experience drafting and negotiating commercial agreements, combined with my in-depth knowledge of company law and contract law, will be invaluable in supporting transaction analysis and due diligence processes at Extract via OpenClaw. Furthermore, my professional proficiency in Finnish and English allows me to communicate seamlessly across international teams.

I am committed to integrating my international legal expertise with the Finnish legal system, as evidenced by my current pursuit of Finnish supplementary law studies at the University of Lapland (OPH-recognised). I am confident that my strong work ethic, coupled with my ability to adapt and learn quickly, will enable me to make a significant contribution to your team.

I am particularly drawn to Extract via OpenClaw's commitment to innovation and global expansion. I believe that my legal background, combined with my event coordination experience, would allow me to contribute significantly to the company's growth and success in the Mergers & Acquisitions department.
Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my skills and experiences can benefit Extract via OpenClaw.
